name: alindesign dotfiles
description: zsh + starship + CLI tools (fd, rg, bat, fzf, jq, delta, eza, zoxide, gh, atuin) + tmux (TPM + catppuccin pre-installed) + neovim (recent build + alindesign LazyVim config) + git config, with optional GPG/SSH commit signing. Configs are sourced from alindesign/dotfiles.

setDefaultShell.description: Set zsh as the default shell for the remote user

gitSigningFormat.description: Format for commit signing. 'gpg' installs gnupg + sets pinentry to loopback. 'ssh' configures git for SSH signing and skips gnupg. 'none' installs neither.

gitSigningKey.description: Signing key. For 'gpg': GPG key ID (e.g. '0xABCD1234' or fingerprint). For 'ssh': absolute path inside the container to your public SSH key (e.g. '/home/vscode/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub'). Empty leaves git unsigned even if format is set.

installNvim.description: Install neovim (recent build from upstream tarball, since apt's nvim is too old for LazyVim) + alindesign LazyVim config + treesitter build deps (gcc, make). Set false to skip nvim entirely.

installGhCli.description: Install GitHub CLI (gh) from the official apt repo and wire it as the git credential helper for github.com / gist.github.com

installAtuin.description: Install atuin (encrypted, syncable shell history with fuzzy-search UI on Ctrl-R). Up-arrow keeps native zsh history.

atuinSyncAddress.description: Atuin sync server URL (sets `sync_address` in ~/.config/atuin/config.toml). Empty leaves the default (api.atuin.sh). Self-hosters: pass your server URL here so `atuin login` targets the right backend.

installTmuxConfig.description: Write a sensible ~/.tmux.conf (C-a prefix, vi mode, mouse on, intuitive splits). tmux itself is always installed.
